selection: For each of the three fixed validation takes, select earliest primary-view hand-detected unknown between initial not-held and first held interval; select latest primary-view hand-detected unknown between last held and final not-held interval. No prediction score participates in selection.
presentation: Paired raw views at -0.3,0,+0.3s; no scores/labels shown to agent reviewer. Review can abstain. Future frames are for offline annotation only, never model input.
purpose: Test hand-presence shortcut on existing unknown transition frames. Agent visual review is not new human confirmation or contact sensor ground truth.
